question: Namita Gokhale, received the Sahitya Akademi Award 2021 for which novel?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Things to Leave Behind**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sahitya Akademi, on 30 December 2021, announced its awards for 2021 for literary works in 20 languages, including novels in Assamese and English.
 
• In English, Author Namita Gokhale won the award for her book Things to Leave Behind.
 
• This year, 7 books of poetry, five short stories, two plays, one each of biography, autobiography, criticism and epic poetry have been chosen for the award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ms Gokhale was awarded for her novel Things to Leave Behind and Ms Pujari for Iyat Ekhan Aaronya Asil.
 
• Daya Prakash Sinha was awarded in Hindi for Samrat Ashok (Play).
 
• Among the winners for poetry were Mwdai Gahai (Bodo), Sanjiv Verenkar (Konkani), Hrushikesh Mallick (Odia), Meethesh Nirmohi (Rajasthani), Vindeshwariprasad Mishr ‘Vinay’ (Sanskrit), Arjun Chawla (Sindhi) and Gorati Venkanna (Telugu).
 
• Books of short stories by writers Raj Rahi (Dogri), Kiran Gurav (Marathi), Khalid Hussain (Punjabi), Niranjan Hansda (Santali) and Ambai (Tamil) were among those chosen for the awards.
 
• A biography by D.S. Nagabhushana in Kannada, an autobiography by George Onakkoor in Malayalam, a work of criticism by Wali Mohd.
 
• Aseer Kashtawari in Kashmiri and a book of epic poetry by Chhabilal Upadhyaya.
 
• For Hindi the Daya Prakash Sinha got the award for the Play
